Your heart remains with mine as others never knew
You wept with me for the broken
For the ones who had no voice
You see that waiting any longer
Becomes another choice
The age of grace has an end on that I tire of grace
But the cries of the oppressed echo loudly in my place
I do not act without cause, nor strike beyond what is due
Each one repaid according to the evil they pursue
I held while the wicked grew, while violence learned new names
I watched them mock the truth and stack pride upon shame
The blood of innocence cried out, it reached me from the ground
Evil poached mercies with hard hearts until goodness could not be found
You see it now, this isn't thoughtless, nor fury breaking through, but my justice standing
up at last to God the weak, and even you.
